title: Min and Max via Out-Params
hints: Start with `lo = hi = v[0];` and loop from index 1 with `std::size_t i = 1`. `std::min` and `std::max` live in `<algorithm>`.

Check `v.empty()` and `return false;` *before* any assignment to `lo` or `hi`. Initializing them to `INT_MAX` / `INT_MIN` up front is fine math but writes the outputs even for empty input, which the tests catch.
